incidents.place: TRP Game Zone, Nana-Mava Road, Rajkot
incidents.what_happened: Fire broke out around 4:30 pm in a temporary fibre/steel dome structure of a crowded game zone during the summer holiday weekend; the structure collapsed and at least 27 people including children were killed.
incidents.cause: fire in game zone structure (reported short-circuit); no fire NOC
incidents.quote: At least 27 persons, including four children, were reportedly killed in a massive fire at a gaming zone in Gujarat's Rajkot on Saturday, May 25.

incidents.what_happened: Huge crowds gathered outside the stadium for the IPL 2025 champions' felicitation event; a stampede broke out at the gates before the ceremony and 11 people died with dozens injured.
incidents.cause: crowd far beyond stadium capacity surged at gates for victory celebration
incidents.quote: A tragic stampede outside M Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru on Wednesday claimed 11 lives during celebrations organised to felicitate IPL 2025 champions Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB).

incidents.what_happened: A tandem paraglider failed to take off properly around 5 pm and crashed into a deep gorge; the 19-year-old tourist passenger from Ahmedabad died and the pilot was injured. Questions were raised about flying after permitted hours.
incidents.cause: failed take-off on tandem flight
incidents.quote: A 19-year-old woman tourist was killed after she crashed and fell into a deep gorge while paragliding in Dharamsala on Saturday.

incidents.place: Bangotu site near Indrunag, Dharamshala, Kangra
incidents.what_happened: A tandem paraglider lost control shortly after take-off from a newly developed site and crashed; the 27-year-old passenger from Ahmedabad died at Tanda Medical College and the pilot was injured. Second fatal tandem crash involving a Gujarat tourist in the area that year.
incidents.cause: loss of control shortly after take-off
incidents.quote: A tragic paragliding accident occurred on Saturday evening at the newly developed Bangotu site near Indrunag, claiming the life of a 27-year-old tourist from Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

incidents.what_happened: A 12-year-old girl from Nagpur fell about 30 feet onto rocks when the zipline cable/belt snapped mid-course; she suffered serious injuries and fractures. The incident came to light when a video went viral a week later.
incidents.cause: zipline cable/harness belt snapped mid-ride
incidents.quote: A disturbing video capturing a 12-year-old girl falling 30 feet from a zipline near Nehru Kund in Manali has gone viral, reigniting concerns over adventure tourism safety in Himachal Pradesh.

incidents.what_happened: A tandem paraglider plunged into a ravine shortly after take-off from a cliff around 5 pm; the 27-year-old woman tourist from Pune and her Nepali instructor both died. The operator lacked authorisation and the panchayat had earlier banned paragliding there.
incidents.cause: crash into ravine shortly after take-off; unauthorised operator
incidents.quote: A 27-year-old woman tourist and her instructor were killed after crashing into a ravine during paragliding in North Goa, police said on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: A 22-member trekking team, mostly from Karnataka, sent by a local agency was caught in a blizzard and whiteout near Sahastra Tal; nine trekkers died and survivors were evacuated by the IAF.
incidents.cause: caught in sudden snowstorm/blizzard at high altitude
incidents.quote: Nine members of a trekking team were killed while six survived after being trapped due to severe weather conditions on their way to Sahastra Tal in Uttarkashi in Uttarakhand, according to the Indian Air Force (IAF) that carried out a rescue operation on Wednesday.

incidents.place: Fun N Food Village, Kapashera, South West Delhi
incidents.what_happened: A 24-year-old woman fell from a height from a swing-type roller coaster ride in the evening after the stand reportedly broke; she died in hospital. The ride area was closed.
incidents.cause: ride stand/support reportedly broke mid-ride
incidents.quote: In a tragic incident, a 24-year-old woman died in a roller coaster accident at Fun N Food Water Park near Kapashera in South West Delhi on Thursday.

incidents.what_happened: Cable cars on the Trikut ropeway collided, leaving dozens of tourists trapped mid-air for up to two days; three people died including one who fell from a helicopter during the IAF airlift.
incidents.cause: ropeway cabin collision/mechanical failure; one death during airlift
incidents.quote: The death toll in Jharkhand's Deoghar cable car accident climbed to three after a person fell down from helicopter while being airlifted on Monday evening.

incidents.place: Entertainment City water park, GIP Mall, Sector 38A, Noida
incidents.what_happened: A 25-year-old man from Delhi visiting with friends complained of breathlessness and collapsed shortly after going down a water slide; he died. Police investigated; cause awaited post-mortem.
incidents.cause: collapsed after water slide; cause unconfirmed
incidents.quote: A 25-year-old man died shortly after taking a slide at a water park located on a mall premises in Noida, prompting an investigation by the local police, officials said.
incidents.spot: Entertainment City water park, GIP Mall

incidents.what_happened: A giant wheel broke apart while operating around 2 pm during peak holiday rush; five tourists from Nagercoil including two children were injured. Preliminary findings pointed to failed welding joints and support structure.
incidents.cause: structural failure of welding joints/support frame
incidents.quote: Five people, including two children, were injured after a giant wheel ride collapsed at an amusement park in Vembayam near Thiruvananthapuram on Thursday, police said.

incidents.what_happened: Lightning struck the playground during a local football match under cloudy skies; two people including a player died and 21 mostly spectators suffered burns.
incidents.cause: lightning strike on open playground during match
incidents.quote: At least two persons were killed and 21 others sustained burn injuries when lightning struck them during a football match in Odisha's Sundergarh district on Sunday, police said.

incidents.what_happened: Two young men were struck by lightning while playing football in the evening as thunderstorms lashed the area; both were declared dead on arrival at Kuchai CHC.
incidents.cause: played on open field during thunderstorm
incidents.quote: 2 men were killed after being struck by lightning while playing football in Jharkhand's West Singhbhum district, police said on Friday.

incidents.place: BPTP Park Serene Society clubhouse pool, Sector 37D, Gurugram
incidents.what_happened: A five-year-old boy left briefly by his grandmother moved from the children's pool to the adults' pool and drowned while pool staff and lifeguards were around; CCTV showed no resuscitation attempt. Two lifeguards were later arrested.
incidents.cause: drowning in club pool; unsupervised child, lifeguard lapse
incidents.quote: A five-year-old boy allegedly drowned in a swimming pool in a club of BPTP Park Serene Society in Sector 37 here on Wednesday evening.

incidents.what_happened: A 55-year-old woman fell while coming down from a giant wheel at a traditional fair at night and died in hospital; her daughter-in-law and grandson were injured. The fair organiser and wheel operator were taken into custody.
incidents.cause: fall from Ferris wheel at fair
incidents.quote: In an unfortunate incident, a middle-aged woman lost her life allegedly after she fell off a Ferris wheel (giant wheel) installed at a fairground in Uttar Pradesh's Noida.

incidents.place: Resort water park, Arnala beach, Virar, Palghar
incidents.what_happened: A 15-year-old boy from Mumbai on a family outing fell while descending a water slide at a resort water park and suffered severe spinal injuries; he died at KEM Hospital weeks later.
incidents.cause: fall on water slide causing spinal injury
incidents.quote: A 15-year-old boy, who was critically injured after falling while playing at a resort in Arnala, Virar, has passed away during medical treatment.

incidents.what_happened: A five-year-old girl drowned in a water park pool while with her parents; the park was closed. A 30-year-old man had died on a ride at the same park three years earlier.
incidents.cause: drowning in water park pool
incidents.quote: A five-year-old girl drowned at a water park in Jamshedpur in Jharkhand's East Singhbhum district on Thursday, police said.

incidents.place: Water park, Alipur, outer north Delhi
incidents.what_happened: A seven-year-old boy drowned around 5 pm in a water park pool while with family; the family buried him without informing police, and the body was later exhumed for post-mortem. Park manager booked.
incidents.cause: drowning in water park pool
incidents.quote: The body of a seven-year-old boy, who drowned in a pool at a water park in outer north Delhi's Alipur area, was exhumed by the police, an official said on Monday.

incidents.what_happened: An eight-year-old boy drowned in the swimming pool of a water park; an inquiry found the pool was under construction and operating without permission. The caretaker was arrested and the body exhumed for post-mortem.
incidents.cause: drowning in unauthorised water park pool
incidents.quote: An eight-year-old boy drowned in a swimming pool at a water park in Uttar Pradesh's Budaun district, police said on Monday.

incidents.place: Numaish (All India Industrial Exhibition), Nampally, Hyderabad
incidents.what_happened: A 12-year-old girl slipped and fell from a joy ride in the exhibition's play arena in the evening and was injured.
incidents.cause: fell from joy ride
incidents.quote: A 12-year-old girl was injured after falling off a joy ride at the Numaish here on Tuesday evening.

incidents.place: Infiniti Mall gaming zone, Malad West, Mumbai
incidents.what_happened: A 19-year-old fractured his leg when two trampoline springs came loose and he fell onto the metal frame in a mall gaming zone; police filed an FIR against the gaming zone management.
incidents.cause: trampoline springs came loose (maintenance)
incidents.quote: The Bangur Nagar police have registered an FIR against the management of Infiniti Mall's gaming zone after a 19-year old fractured his leg in a trampoline incident.

incidents.what_happened: An inflatable jumping house deflated within about 30 seconds after a power failure stopped its blower, trapping five children under the fabric; bystanders pulled them out and one girl briefly fainted. There was allegedly no generator backup.
incidents.cause: inflatable collapsed after power cut; torn fabric, no backup
incidents.quote: A fun outing at Patalpani nearly turned into a nightmare on Saturday evening when a Mickey Mouse-themed inflatable jumping house suddenly collapsed after a power failure, trapping five children under its fabric.

incidents.place: Green Mountain Park, Al Hada, Taif
incidents.what_happened: A pendulum ('360') ride loaded with visitors snapped and crashed to the ground in the evening; 23 people were injured, three critically. Authorities closed the park and opened an investigation.
incidents.cause: structural failure of pendulum ride arm
incidents.quote: At least 23 people were injured, including several young women, three of whom are in critical condition, when an amusement park ride collapsed on Wednesday evening in the Al Hada district of Taif, a popular mountain resort city in western Saudi Arabia, according to local authorities.

incidents.what_happened: A carriage on the Jetline roller coaster partly derailed and riders fell to the ground; one person was killed and seven, including children, were hospitalised. The ride was later closed permanently.
incidents.cause: roller coaster partial derailment
incidents.quote: One person was killed and several others injured when a roller coaster derailed in Stockholm on Sunday, Swedish TV reported.

incidents.place: Castellammare di Stabia to Monte Faito cable car, near Naples
incidents.what_happened: A cable car cabin crashed to the ground after a supporting cable snapped, a week after the service reopened for the season; four people died (the operator and three foreign tourists) and one was critically injured. Sixteen people were evacuated from a second stalled cabin.
incidents.cause: supporting/traction cable snapped
incidents.quote: Four people died and one suffered life-threatening injuries after a cable car crashed to the ground near Naples in southern Italy on Thursday, mountain rescue services and firefighters said.

incidents.what_happened: A tourist hot-air balloon carrying 21 people caught fire around 8 am and fell; eight people died and 13 survived with injuries. The pilot reportedly blamed a fire from a reserve torch in the basket.
incidents.cause: hot-air balloon fire in flight
incidents.quote: Thirteen people survived and were taken to hospitals, Santa Catarina's military fire brigade said, adding that 21 people were on board including the pilot.

incidents.what_happened: A pole of the cable car broke and a cabin collided with it; one person died and 10 were injured, and 174 passengers in 24 stranded cabins were rescued over 23 hours. Thirteen people were detained.
incidents.cause: cable car pole broke; cabin hit pole
incidents.quote: One person was killed and 10 others injured in the southern Turkish province of Antalya when a cable car cabin collided with a broken pole, prompting a massive operation that rescued a further 174 passengers, Turkish officials said on Saturday (local time).

incidents.place: Koh Yao Elephant Care Centre, Phang Nga
incidents.what_happened: A 23-year-old Spanish tourist bathing an elephant at a sanctuary was struck by the stressed animal's trunk and killed.
incidents.cause: elephant bathing activity; panicked elephant
incidents.quote: The 23-year-old woman was hit by the stressed animal's trunk at the Koh Yao Elephant Care Centre in Phang Nga province, according to police.

incidents.what_happened: An Indian tourist posing for a photograph with a tiger was lunged at when the tiger turned aggressive instead of sitting on the trainer's command; staff rescued him and he suffered minor injuries. Incident date not stated; date is the report date.
incidents.cause: photo session with captive tiger
incidents.quote: An Indian tourist was attacked by a tiger, when he was trying to take a photograph with the wild animal at the popular Tiger Kingdom.

incidents.what_happened: An avalanche hit 41 trainee mountaineers and instructors of the Nehru Institute of Mountaineering descending from the peak at about 14,000 ft at 8:45 am. This early report gave at least 10 dead; the final toll later rose (widely reported as 27), not confirmed from an opened page.
incidents.cause: avalanche during mountaineering training course
incidents.quote: A total of 41 persons, including 34 trainee mountaineers and seven instructors from the Nehru Institute of Mountaineering (NIM), Uttarkashi, were caught in the avalanche at 8.45 am, a statement from the institute said.

incidents.place: Rajgad Water Park Resort adventure park, Bhor tehsil, Pune
incidents.what_happened: A 28-year-old IT professional stood on a small iron stool to clip her safety hook at the top of a zipline tower; the stool slipped and she fell about 30 feet onto a railing and died. Seven people including owner and operator were booked for negligence.
incidents.cause: fell from zipline tower while clipping in; unsafe platform
incidents.quote: A 28-year-old female IT professional died after falling from a zipline tower at an adventure park in Bhor tehsil of Pune district, police said on Monday.

incidents.what_happened: A 57-year-old tourist from Thane was grievously injured when the tandem paraglider crashed while landing in the evening; he died at Kullu Regional Hospital. A case was registered and the tourism department told pilots to follow aero sports rules.
incidents.cause: tandem paraglider crashed on landing
incidents.quote: A 57-year-old tourist from Maharashtra was killed in a paraglider crash at Raison, 11 km from here yesterday.

incidents.what_happened: A 26-year-old woman tourist from Hyderabad fell from a height during a tandem flight because the pilot failed to secure her safety belt; she died. The pilot was registered and equipment approved; a magisterial inquiry and FIR followed.
incidents.cause: harness/safety belt not secured by pilot
incidents.quote: A 26-year-old female tourist from Hyderabad died in a paragliding crash at Kullu's Dobhi village on Sunday, according to police.

incidents.what_happened: The cable of a cargo ropeway carrying construction material and six people snapped around 3 pm near the first tower; all six (lift operators, labourers and two others) died. The public passenger ropeway had been shut that morning due to weather.
incidents.cause: cargo ropeway cable snapped
incidents.quote: Six persons died after the cable wire of a cargo ropeway snapped at Pavagadh Hill in Gujarat's Panchmahal district on Saturday, officials said.

incidents.place: Tiger Valley viewpoint, Pollachi-Valparai road, Coimbatore
incidents.what_happened: A German tourist riding a two-wheeler through elephant habitat kept going despite locals' warnings; a wild elephant charged, knocked him off and he died in hospital. Forest department increased patrolling.
incidents.cause: approached wild elephant on ghat road despite warnings
incidents.quote: As he approached the accident spot, an elephant charged at him, knocking him off his vehicle and inflicting severe injuries.

incidents.place: Bannerghatta National Park leopard safari, Bengaluru
incidents.what_happened: A leopard climbed onto a safari bus around 1 pm and pawed through a gap in the window mesh, injuring a 56-year-old woman visitor; non-AC safari buses were halted.
incidents.cause: gap in safari bus window mesh
incidents.quote: A woman was injured after a leopard allegedly tried to attack her through the mesh window of a safari bus in Bannerghatta National Park here on Thursday, officials said.

incidents.what_happened: A 37-year-old woman lost balance while taking a selfie from a hill and fell into a 100-metre-deep gorge, dying on the spot; her husband got lost searching and was rescued by SDRF.
incidents.cause: selfie at cliff edge
incidents.quote: A woman died after falling into a gorge while taking a selfie from a hill in Pithoragarh district here on Thursday, police said.

incidents.place: Nana's Thumb viewpoint, Naneghat, Junnar, Pune
incidents.what_happened: A 22-year-old visitor slipped and fell from a cliff near the viewpoint amid dense fog and strong winds in the monsoon; he was found dead after an overnight search using a thermal drone.
incidents.cause: slipped at cliff edge in monsoon fog and wind
incidents.quote: A tourist who fell into a deep gorge at the Naneghat mountain pass in Pune district has been found dead after an extensive search operation that continued overnight.

incidents.what_happened: A 21-year-old woman visiting the fort with her husband slipped on a rain-slick trail around 5 pm and fell nearly 400 feet, dying on the spot. Came days after a forest department monsoon advisory.
incidents.cause: slipped on wet trail on fort in early monsoon
incidents.quote: She suffered severe head and facial injuries and died on the spot due to heavy bleeding.

incidents.what_happened: A 27-year-old travel content creator filming a reel at the waterfall in the monsoon slipped and fell about 300 feet into a gorge; she was rescued after hours but died during treatment.
incidents.cause: slipped while filming near gorge edge in heavy rain
incidents.quote: The incident happened at Kumbhe waterfall in Maharashtra's Raigad on July 16.

incidents.what_happened: A 38-year-old trekker in an organised group developed severe headache, nausea and breathlessness while ascending and died at night at Phedang, about 25 km from Yuksom, reportedly of high-altitude complications.
incidents.cause: suspected high-altitude sickness
incidents.quote: A 38-year-old trekker tragically died along the Goechala trekking route in West Sikkim on the night of November 18, reportedly due to high-altitude complications.

incidents.place: Near Thorong La, Annapurna Circuit, Manang
incidents.what_happened: A 54-year-old Indian trekker complained of chest pain after five hours of walking at about 4,200 m and collapsed; he died while being carried on a stretcher to a health post.
incidents.cause: high-altitude sickness
incidents.quote: A 54-year-old Indian national who was trekking in Nepal's Annapurna Circuit died of high-altitude sickness near Thorang Pass at an altitude of 4,200 metres on Tuesday morning.

incidents.what_happened: A 34-year-old engineer collapsed on the pitch in the 14th over of a local match while walking to meet his batting partner; players tried CPR and he was declared dead on arrival at hospital. Exact match date not stated; date is the report date.
incidents.cause: suspected heart attack during cricket match
incidents.quote: Players from both sides had reportedly tried to perform CPR on him, but he was pronounced dead.

incidents.what_happened: A local club cricketer hit a six and collapsed while jogging to celebrate with his partner; teammates and opponents tried to revive him but he died. Date approximate (article does not state the day).
incidents.cause: heart attack during cricket match
incidents.quote: A tragic incident unfolded in Ferozepur, Punjab, when a local cricketer collapsed and died of a heart attack moments after hitting a six-just one run short of his half-century.
incidents.evidence: headline-only: quote not found by plain fetch; confirm with a browser fetch before publishing

incidents.what_happened: A 34-year-old cricketer collapsed with chest pain while celebrating his team's win in an Aegis South Zone tournament match and died of a heart attack en route to Bowring Hospital.
incidents.cause: heart attack after match
incidents.quote: The incident occurred during a match between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu at the RSI cricket ground in Bengaluru on Thursday, 22 February.

incidents.what_happened: A 17-year-old Junior National Games gold medallist powerlifter died when a 270 kg barbell fell on her neck during a squat attempt in a gym training session; her trainer was also hurt.
incidents.cause: 270 kg barbell fell on neck during supervised squat
incidents.quote: In a tragic incident in Bikaner, Rajasthan on Wednesday, a 17-year-old powerlifter died in the midst of a training routine.

incidents.what_happened: A 40-year-old regular gym-goer slowed down and fell off a treadmill during a morning workout; CPR by fellow members failed and he died of a suspected heart attack.
incidents.cause: suspected heart attack on treadmill
incidents.quote: In a video that surfaced on social media on Saturday, a man was seen collapsing and dying while running on a treadmill at a local gym in Ghaziabad's Wave City area.

incidents.what_happened: A 52-year-old man collapsed while walking between machines during his routine 6:45 am workout and died of a heart attack; caught on gym CCTV.
incidents.cause: heart attack during workout
incidents.quote: A 52-year-old man collapsed and died of a heart attack while working out at a gym in Jabalpur on Friday.

incidents.what_happened: A 39-year-old man felt dizzy during a morning workout and collapsed walking to the water cooler; he was declared dead on arrival. Post-mortem reportedly found 60-70% arterial blockage, likely undiagnosed.
incidents.cause: heart attack; undiagnosed coronary blockage
incidents.quote: The incident occurred on Friday at around 7:15am at Nitrro Gym.

incidents.place: Kabaddi tournament, Rupal Heri village, Fatehgarh Sahib
incidents.what_happened: A kabaddi player who had earlier had three heart stents collapsed during a raid in a village tournament and was brought dead to hospital. Date approximate (report date).
incidents.cause: cardiac arrest during kabaddi raid; prior heart disease
incidents.quote: Reports suggest that he suffered a massive cardiac arrest on the field.

incidents.what_happened: A 26-year-old player from Chhattisgarh fell ill and died minutes later during the final of an inter-state Durga Puja kabaddi tournament. Date approximate (day before report).
incidents.cause: collapsed during kabaddi final
incidents.quote: As it is perfectly said 'death knows no time', tragedy struck a Kabaddi match organised at Tarabod village under Komna Police limits in Nuapada district when a 26-year-old player from Chhattisgarh fell ill and died minutes later.

incidents.what_happened: A 22-year-old college student collapsed immediately after being pulled down during a raid in a district-level kabaddi tournament and was brought dead to Panruti GH; police suspected sudden cardiac arrest.
incidents.cause: collapsed after tackle in kabaddi; suspected cardiac
incidents.quote: In a tragic incident, a 22-year-old private college student died while playing Kabbadi at his native Mannadikuppam village near Panruti in Cuddalore district of Tamil Nadu last night.

incidents.what_happened: During heavy rain and thunderstorm at a local football match, spectators sheltering under a tent beside the playground were struck by lightning; two died and three were injured.
incidents.cause: sheltered under tent beside open ground during thunderstorm
incidents.quote: Two spectators of a local football match were killed and three others injured as lightning struck a playground in Jharkhand's Dumka district, police said.

incidents.what_happened: A 19-year-old polytechnic student practising for a sports competition stepped into the javelin throw zone to fetch a football and was struck in the neck by a javelin thrown by another trainee; he was declared dead at the district hospital.
incidents.cause: walked into active javelin throw zone; no zone separation
incidents.quote: A 19-year-old student lost his life on Saturday after a javelin pierced his neck during a practice session at Uttarakhand's Goralchaud ground in Champawat district, police said.

incidents.place: School ground, Purar, Goregaon, Mangaon, Raigad
incidents.what_happened: During javelin practice for a taluka-level meet, a 15-year-old bent to tie his shoelace and was struck in the head by a javelin thrown by another student; he died.
incidents.cause: javelin practice without throw-zone control
incidents.quote: A 15-year-old boy died after a javelin thrown by another student during a practice session pierced his head at a school in Maharashtra's Raigad district, the police said on Thursday.

incidents.what_happened: A 25-year-old private-sector employee collapsed while playing badminton on an indoor court on a Sunday night and was declared dead at hospital; suspected heart attack, part of a run of similar cases in Telangana.
incidents.cause: suspected heart attack during badminton
incidents.quote: A youth died of suspected cardiac arrest while playing badminton with friends in Hyderabad.

incidents.place: Half-marathon route near Nehru Stadium, Indore
incidents.what_happened: A 25-year-old runner from Faridabad collapsed about 500 m from the finish of a 21-km half-marathon; a doctor gave CPR but he was declared dead at MYH hospital. Suspected cardiac arrest.
incidents.cause: suspected cardiac arrest during half-marathon
incidents.quote: A 25-year-old participant in a 21-km half-marathon collapsed near the finish line and died during the event in Indore on Sunday.

incidents.place: Satara Hill Half Marathon route, Satara
incidents.what_happened: A 65-year-old runner from Pune developed chest pain running downhill and collapsed shortly before the finish; a participating cardiologist started CPR and he had an angioplasty, but died.
incidents.cause: heart attack during hill half-marathon
incidents.quote: A 65-year-old runner from Pune died after suffering a heart attack while participating in the Satara Hill Half Marathon on Sunday.

incidents.place: Football turf, Pension Moola, Chembukkavu, Thrissur
incidents.what_happened: An 18-year-old college student collapsed while playing football on a turf; teammates rushed him to a private hospital but he could not be saved.
incidents.cause: sudden collapse during football
incidents.quote: An 18-year-old collapsed and died while playing football on the turf in Pension Moola, Chembukkavu here.

incidents.place: John de Baptist Dando Ground, Cana-Benaulim, South Goa
incidents.what_happened: A 26-year-old substitute collapsed three minutes after coming on in an inter-village tournament match; CPR was given on the field and he was declared dead on arrival at the district hospital. Eyewitnesses said no ambulance was stationed at the venue.
incidents.cause: sudden collapse during football; no ambulance on site
incidents.quote: Players and officials immediately rushed to his aid, administering CPR on the field before he was stretchered off.

incidents.what_happened: A 15-year-old girl suffered a head injury from a ball during cricket practice at school; after treatment in Kottakkal, Kozhikode and Maharashtra she died.
incidents.cause: struck on head by cricket ball at school practice
incidents.quote: A 15-year-old girl died after sustaining a head injury during cricket practice at her school in Kottakkal, Malappuram.

incidents.what_happened: An 11-year-old government school student was hit on the head by a stray ball while several groups played cricket on the same ground; he collapsed and died three days later.
incidents.cause: stray cricket ball from crowded shared ground
incidents.quote: Three days after he was hit on the head by a cricket ball at a playground inside the District Collectorate complex in Kancheepuram, the 11-year-old Class 6 student succumbed on Saturday.

incidents.place: Hotel swimming pool, Arpora, North Goa
incidents.what_happened: A five-year-old girl drowned in a hotel swimming pool between 4:20 and 4:50 pm; police found the management had not deployed a lifeguard and booked the hotel management and staff for negligence.
incidents.cause: drowning in unattended hotel pool; no lifeguard
incidents.quote: Preliminary investigation revealed that the hotel management, including the Managing Director and staff, allegedly failed to deploy a lifeguard at the swimming pool, leaving it unattended at the time of the incident.

incidents.place: Hotel swimming pool, AB Road, Gwalior
incidents.what_happened: A 7-year-old boy drowned in a hotel pool during a night pool party; the family cremated him, then CCTV surfaced and police exhumed the body. Family alleged no lifeguard, depth markers or life jackets.
incidents.cause: drowning at hotel pool party; alleged no lifeguard
incidents.quote: A disturbing CCTV footage showing a 7-year-old boy drowning in a swimming pool at a hotel in Madhya Pradesh's Gwalior surfaced on Thursday.

incidents.what_happened: During a tourist pony/horse ride, an 11-year-old boy from Mumbai and a 63-year-old woman from Tamil Nadu fell off the horse; the boy died of head injuries and the woman was referred to SKIMS in critical condition.
incidents.cause: fall from tourist horse ride
incidents.quote: An 11-year-old tourist from Mumbai died of head injuries after he fell off a horse at tourist resort of Sonmarg in central Kashmir's Ganderbal district on Tuesday.

incidents.place: ICON Park, International Drive, Orlando, Florida
incidents.what_happened: A 14-year-old boy visiting from Missouri fell from the 430-ft Orlando FreeFall drop tower shortly after 11 pm and died in hospital; the ride was closed and later dismantled. Investigators focused on seat restraint/sensor adjustments.
incidents.cause: rider fell from drop tower; restraint inadequate for rider size
incidents.quote: A 14-year-old boy from Missouri fell to his death while on a new ride at an Orlando amusement park, authorities said.

incidents.what_happened: After a football match, riots broke out and police fired tear gas inside the stadium; fans crushed at exits and at least 125 people died (early count of 174 revised down for double counting).
incidents.cause: tear gas in packed stadium; crush at locked/narrow exits
incidents.quote: At least 125 people have been killed in a stampede at a football stadium in Indonesia's eastern city of Malang, one of the deadliest sports disasters in the world.

incidents.what_happened: A 23-year-old man from Kozhikode working in Dubai collapsed and died on the spot while playing football on a turf at night; doctors confirmed a heart attack.
incidents.cause: heart attack during football
incidents.quote: A young man from Kozhikode collapsed and died while playing football on a turf field in Dubai on Saturday night.

incidents.what_happened: A 24-year-old bank employee reportedly suffered a seizure and collapsed shortly after a city half-marathon began; the event medical team moved him to Royapettah GH where he was declared dead.
incidents.cause: collapse/seizure during half-marathon
incidents.quote: A 24-year-old man allegedly swooned to death while running a half-marathon event in the city on Sunday.

incidents.what_happened: A 36-year-old software engineer finished the 42.2 km Hyderabad Hi-Tech Full Marathon, collected his medal and collapsed walking to the breakfast area; CPR was given but he was declared dead at 8:45 am.
incidents.cause: post-race collapse, suspected cardiac
incidents.quote: A 36-year-old software engineer died shortly after completing a full marathon at Gachibowli Stadium in Hyderabad on Sunday morning.

incidents.what_happened: A 31-year-old Bengaluru tech worker collapsed on the uphill route of the 21-km category and died of apparent cardiac arrest.
incidents.cause: apparent cardiac arrest on uphill half-marathon
incidents.quote: A 31-year-old runner died of an apparent cardiac arrest while participating in the second edition of the Nandi Hills Monsoon Marathon held at the foothills of the popular tourist destination in Chikkaballapur district on Sunday, August 9.

incidents.place: Tata Mumbai Marathon route, Marine Drive and Haji Ali, Mumbai
incidents.what_happened: Two runners, aged 74 and 40, collapsed and died during the marathon and 22 others were hospitalised for dehydration and other reasons.
incidents.cause: collapse during marathon; dehydration among hospitalised
incidents.quote: A 74-year-old man and one more person collapsed and died, while 22 others were hospitalised during the annual TATA Mumbai Marathon in Mumbai on Sunday.

incidents.place: Playground, Surinje near Surathkal, Dakshina Kannada
incidents.what_happened: A 15-year-old Class 10 government school student collapsed on court while playing volleyball with friends and died; captured on CCTV. Date is the report date.
incidents.cause: sudden collapse during volleyball
incidents.quote: In a tragic incident, a 15-year-old Class 10 student died after suddenly collapsing while playing a volleyball match with his friends in Karnataka's Dakshina Kannada district.

incidents.what_happened: A 'Tsunami' giant swing with about 15 riders broke around 7 pm due to an alleged mechanical fault and collapsed mid-operation; a police inspector was killed and around a dozen people injured. Ride operations were halted and an inquiry ordered.
incidents.cause: mechanical failure of giant swing at fair
incidents.quote: The incident took place at the mela venue in Faridabad on Saturday when a giant swing malfunctioned and collapsed mid-operation, killing a police inspector and injuring others.

incidents.what_happened: A 'Dragon Swing' packed with children snapped while coming down at high speed at a fair set up near a government school; 14 students (13 girls, one boy) were injured. A magisterial inquiry was ordered.
incidents.cause: swing ride snapped mid-operation; alleged safety lapses
incidents.quote: Fourteen students from a local government school were injured in the accident, officials said.

incidents.place: Broken Beach cliff, Bunga Mekar, Nusa Penida, Bali
incidents.what_happened: An Indian tourist posing for a photo at a beach-view cliff slipped and fell about 40 m into the sea around 4:20 pm and died; Basarnas recovered the body.
incidents.cause: posing for photo at cliff edge
incidents.quote: An Indian national died after slipping into the sea while posing for a photo at a popular beach-view cliff in Nusa Penida, a small island east of Bali, on Saturday.

incidents.place: Jungle Flight zipline park, Thep Sadet, Doi Saket, Chiang Mai
incidents.what_happened: A large tree fell onto a 15-m-high cable suspension bridge at a zipline attraction as a Chinese couple crossed it; both fell to the ground, the wife died and the husband suffered fractures. Heavy rain was blamed and the park closed for inspection.
incidents.cause: tree fell on zipline suspension bridge after heavy rain
incidents.quote: A Chinese couple's trip to Chiang Mai turned tragic when a large tree fell on the cable bridge zipline they were walking on, causing both to fall from a height.

incidents.what_happened: A roller coaster carrying 22 locals and foreign tourists aged 11-44 suffered a reported technical failure around 9 pm; ten riders had minor injuries. Police investigated.
incidents.cause: roller coaster technical failure
incidents.quote: Ten people sustained minor injuries in a roller coaster incident at a theme park here.

incidents.what_happened: Near miss: a 13-year-old girl lost her balance on an over-height Ferris wheel and hung from a metal bar for about 30 seconds until operators rotated the wheel and a worker rescued her. The wheel exceeded its authorised 60-ft height and lacked permits. Date approximate (report date 6 Dec).
incidents.cause: unauthorised over-height Ferris wheel; rider unsecured
incidents.quote: A major accident was narrowly avoided in Uttar Pradesh when a 13-year-old girl lost her balance on a Ferris wheel and clung to a metal bar for nearly 30 seconds before being rescued by the operators.

incidents.place: Indiranagar Sawan Mahotsav fair, Ghazipur police area, Lucknow
incidents.what_happened: A Ferris wheel trolley detached and fell to the ground at night during a Sawan fair; several people were injured and two women were critical.
incidents.cause: Ferris wheel trolley detached
incidents.quote: Preliminary information suggests that one of the ride's trolleys detached unexpectedly and fell to the ground.

incidents.what_happened: During the Diwali holiday rush, a young Pune tourist on a hired horse ride asked for a jump; the horse picked up pace, he lost control and fell into a 30-foot pit near the valley and was injured.
incidents.cause: horse ride near valley edge; rider requested jump
incidents.quote: As a result, the rider lost control and fell into a 30-foot-deep pit near the valley on Tuesday.

incidents.place: Detian Waterfall Scenic Area, Daxin county, Guangxi
incidents.what_happened: A 'Magic Carpet' escalator-type ride for viewing the waterfall malfunctioned in the afternoon; one tourist died and 60 were injured (one severely). The ride was shut down.
incidents.cause: malfunction of scenic-area 'Magic Carpet' ride
incidents.quote: The incident caused the death of one tourist and injuries to 60 others, including one severe injury and 59 minor injuries, according to local authorities.
